offers.name: Send messages
offers.description: Other products send emails, texts, WhatsApp and push messages through the website's own provider keys.

offers.name: Forward events
offers.description: Other products pass their events on to the merchant's webhook addresses, signed.

offers.name: Read permissions
offers.description: Other products list this product's permissions, for the roles of the website's staff.

offers.name: Export a person's data
offers.description: Other products ask this product for everything it keeps about one person.

offers.name: Erase a person's data
offers.description: Other products ask this product to erase or anonymize one person's data.

features.name: WhatsApp
features.description: Sends WhatsApp messages through the merchant's own provider: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API, Twilio, or any WhatsApp gateway with an HTTP API.

features.name: Email
features.description: Sends email through the merchant's own provider: SMTP, Resend, SendGrid, Mailgun or Amazon SES.

features.name: SMS
features.description: Sends SMS through the merchant's own provider: Twilio, or any SMS gateway with an HTTP API.

features.name: Browser push
features.description: Visitors who allow it get push notifications in their browser, with the merchant's own push keys.

features.name: Staff push
features.description: The merchant's staff get push notifications in their browsers, with the merchant's own push keys.

features.name: Outgoing webhooks
features.description: Sends signed events (message sent, message failed, recipient unsubscribed) to the merchant's own URLs, retried on failure.

features.name: Fallback channel
features.description: When a message fails on its channel after its retries, it moves to the next of its fallback channels, in order (for example WhatsApp, then SMS, then email; browser push too). A template can have its own order.

features.name: Quiet hours
features.description: Messages that are not urgent wait for the end of the quiet hours in the recipient's time zone: windows per weekday, with minutes, for the channels each one names.

features.name: Send limits
features.description: Caps the messages one recipient gets per hour and per day: optional messages only, or all of them.

features.name: Delayed send
features.description: A send can name a later time; the message goes out on the first use of the website after it, so it can be late on a quiet site.

features.name: Multi-language templates
features.description: Each template can have a version per language; recipients get their language, else the default version.

features.name: Merchant send API
features.description: The merchant's own server sends with its own template keys, and the admin widgets: delivery log, template editor and send a message.
